using Random

# A synthetic week, hour by hour: household load, rooftop solar and three price
# lists (yen per kWh). Nothing here is measured; the seed fixes every number.
function synthetic_week(seed, days)
    rng = Xoshiro(seed)
    hours = 24 * days
    bump(h, centre, width) = exp(-((h - centre) / width)^2)

    # Each day has its own cloud cover, which also moves the market's midday price.
    clear = [0.3 + 0.7 * rand(rng) for _ in 1:days]
    load = zeros(hours)
    solar = zeros(hours)
    spot = zeros(hours)
    noise = 0.0
    for t in 1:hours
        h = (t - 1) % 24
        sun = clear[(t - 1) ÷ 24 + 1]
        load[t] = (0.35 + 0.9 * bump(h, 7.5, 1.5) + 1.5 * bump(h, 19.5, 2.5)) * (0.85 + 0.3 * rand(rng))
        solar[t] = 4.0 * sun * max(0.0, sin(pi * (h - 6) / 12))^1.5
        noise = 0.7 * noise + 1.5 * randn(rng)
        spot[t] = max(1.0, 16.0 + 7.0 * bump(h, 8, 2) + 18.0 * bump(h, 19, 2.5) - 9.0 * sun * bump(h, 12.5, 3.5) + noise)
    end
    flat = fill(30.0, hours)
    tou = [(t - 1) % 24 < 7 || (t - 1) % 24 >= 23 ? 18.0 : (t - 1) % 24 < 17 ? 30.0 : 42.0 for t in 1:hours]
    return (; load, solar, flat, tou, spot)
end

function main(inputs, report)
    outputs = Dict{String,Any}()
    s = Tsugumi.input(inputs, "settings")
    week = synthetic_week(s["seed"], Int(s["days"]))
    outputs["scenario"] = merge(s, Dict(
        "load" => week.load, "solar" => week.solar, "flat" => week.flat, "tou" => week.tou, "spot" => week.spot))

    day(t) = (t - 1) / 24
    prices = [Dict("day" => day(t), "tariff" => name, "price" => round(series[t]; digits=2))
              for (name, series) in (("Flat", week.flat), ("Time-of-use", week.tou), ("Market-linked", week.spot))
              for t in eachindex(series)]
    power = [Dict("day" => day(t), "kind" => name, "kW" => round(series[t]; digits=3))
             for (name, series) in (("House consumption", week.load), ("Solar", week.solar)) for t in eachindex(series)]
    xaxis = Dict("field" => "day", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Day", "axis" => Dict("tickMinStep" => 1))
    report.vegalite(Dict(
        "\$schema" => "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v6.json",
        "background" => "white",
        "title" => "A made-up week (data from random numbers, seed = $(s["seed"]))",
        "usermeta" => Dict("load" => week.load, "solar" => week.solar, "flat" => week.flat, "tou" => week.tou, "spot" => week.spot),
        "resolve" => Dict("scale" => Dict("color" => "independent")),
        "vconcat" => [
            Dict("width" => 620, "height" => 130, "data" => Dict("values" => prices), "mark" => Dict("type" => "line", "strokeWidth" => 1.8, "interpolate" => "step-after"),
                 "encoding" => Dict("x" => xaxis, "y" => Dict("field" => "price", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Price (yen/kWh)"),
                                    "color" => Dict("field" => "tariff", "type" => "nominal", "title" => "Tariff",
                                                    "scale" => Dict("domain" => ["Flat", "Time-of-use", "Market-linked"], "range" => ["#8a8880", "#1baf7a", "#2a78d6"])))),
            Dict("width" => 620, "height" => 110, "data" => Dict("values" => power), "mark" => Dict("type" => "line", "strokeWidth" => 1.8),
                 "encoding" => Dict("x" => xaxis, "y" => Dict("field" => "kW", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Power (kW)"),
                                    "color" => Dict("field" => "kind", "type" => "nominal", "title" => "Power",
                                                    "scale" => Dict("domain" => ["House consumption", "Solar"], "range" => ["#eb6834", "#eda100"])))),
        ]))

    return outputs
end

# The dynamic program of the demo (the same file is in schedule, capacities,
# tariffs and check, so that each Card can be read and rerun alone).
#
# State: the charge of the battery, on a grid of `step` kWh. Each hour it moves
# to any level the power limit reaches, and the bill of that hour follows. The
# battery starts half full and must end where it started, so no stored energy
# is spent for free.

# Half of the round-trip loss is on the way in, half on the way out: `oneway`
# is sqrt(round-trip efficiency). A positive `stored` draws stored / oneway from
# the house's connection; a negative one gives it back -stored * oneway.
ac_energy(stored, oneway) = stored > 0 ? stored / oneway : stored * oneway

# The bill of one hour: what is bought costs `price`, what is sold earns `sell`.
hour_bill(grid, price, sell) = grid > 0 ? price * grid : sell * grid

function optimal_schedule(net_load, price, export_ratio; capacity, power, efficiency, step)
    hours = length(net_load)
    levels = round(Int, capacity / step)
    oneway = sqrt(efficiency)
    start = levels ÷ 2
    up = floor(Int, power * oneway / step + 1e-9)   # the most it can gain in an hour, in levels
    down = floor(Int, power / oneway / step + 1e-9) # the most it can lose

    # Backward: cost_to_go[s + 1] is the least bill from this hour on when the charge is s levels.
    cost_to_go = fill(Inf, levels + 1)
    cost_to_go[start + 1] = 0.0
    choice = zeros(Int, levels + 1, hours)
    for t in hours:-1:1
        next = copy(cost_to_go)
        for s in 0:levels
            best = hour_bill(net_load[t], price[t], export_ratio * price[t]) + next[s + 1] # staying wins ties
            best_to = s
            for to in max(0, s - down):min(levels, s + up)
                grid = net_load[t] + ac_energy((to - s) * step, oneway)
                cost = hour_bill(grid, price[t], export_ratio * price[t]) + next[to + 1]
                if cost < best - 1e-9
                    best, best_to = cost, to
                end
            end
            cost_to_go[s + 1] = best
            choice[s + 1, t] = best_to
        end
    end

    # Forward: follow the choices from the start.
    charge = zeros(hours + 1)
    grid = zeros(hours)
    s = start
    charge[1] = s * step
    for t in 1:hours
        to = choice[s + 1, t]
        grid[t] = net_load[t] + ac_energy((to - s) * step, oneway)
        s = to
        charge[t + 1] = s * step
    end
    bill = sum(hour_bill(grid[t], price[t], export_ratio * price[t]) for t in 1:hours; init=0.0)
    return (; bill, charge, grid)
end

no_battery_bill(net_load, price, export_ratio) =
    sum(hour_bill(net_load[t], price[t], export_ratio * price[t]) for t in eachindex(net_load))

# Energy that left the battery, in full cycles of its capacity.
function cycles(charge, capacity)
    capacity > 0 || return 0.0
    return sum(max(0.0, charge[t] - charge[t + 1]) for t in 1:length(charge)-1) / capacity
end

using Printf
include("dp.jl")

function main(inputs, report)
    m = Tsugumi.input(inputs, "scenario")
    tariff = inputs.params["tariff"]
    tariff in ("flat", "tou", "spot") || error("tariff is flat, tou or spot, not $tariff")
    price = Float64.(m[tariff])
    net_load = Float64.(m["load"]) .- Float64.(m["solar"])
    export_ratio = m["export_ratio"]
    capacity, efficiency = m["capacity_kwh"], m["round_trip_efficiency"]

    best = optimal_schedule(net_load, price, export_ratio; capacity, power=m["power_kw"], efficiency, step=m["soc_step_kwh"])
    baseline = no_battery_bill(net_load, price, export_ratio)
    saved = baseline - best.bill
    used = cycles(best.charge, capacity)
    report.log(string(@sprintf("%s: without battery %.1f yen, with battery %.1f yen, saved %.1f yen, %.2f cycles", tariff, baseline, best.bill, saved, used)))

    day(t) = (t - 1) / 24
    prices = [Dict("day" => day(t), "price" => round(price[t]; digits=2)) for t in eachindex(price)]
    flows = [Dict("day" => day(t), "kWh" => round(best.charge[t + 1] - best.charge[t]; digits=3),
                  "kind" => best.charge[t + 1] >= best.charge[t] ? "Charge" : "Discharge") for t in eachindex(price)]
    levels = [Dict("day" => day(t), "kWh" => best.charge[t]) for t in eachindex(best.charge)]
    xaxis(title) = Dict("field" => "day", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => title, "scale" => Dict("domain" => [0, length(price) / 24]))
    name = Dict("flat" => "flat", "tou" => "time-of-use", "spot" => "market-linked")[tariff]
    report.vegalite(Dict(
        "\$schema" => "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v6.json",
        "background" => "white",
        "title" => Dict("text" => @sprintf("Optimal operation, %s tariff: %.0f yen saved in a week", name, saved),
                        "subtitle" => @sprintf("Without a battery %.0f yen → with one %.0f yen, %.1f kWh · %.1f kW · round-trip efficiency %.0f%%, %.1f cycles", baseline, best.bill, capacity, m["power_kw"], 100efficiency, used)),
        "usermeta" => Dict("tariff" => tariff, "baseline" => baseline, "bill" => best.bill, "saved" => saved, "cycles" => used,
                           "charge" => best.charge, "grid" => best.grid),
        "vconcat" => [
            Dict("width" => 620, "height" => 90, "data" => Dict("values" => prices),
                 "mark" => Dict("type" => "line", "interpolate" => "step-after", "color" => "#2a78d6", "strokeWidth" => 1.8),
                 "encoding" => Dict("x" => xaxis(""), "y" => Dict("field" => "price", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Price (yen/kWh)"))),
            Dict("width" => 620, "height" => 90, "data" => Dict("values" => flows),
                 "mark" => Dict("type" => "bar", "width" => 2.5),
                 "encoding" => Dict("x" => xaxis(""), "y" => Dict("field" => "kWh", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Charge / discharge (kWh)"),
                                    "color" => Dict("field" => "kind", "type" => "nominal", "title" => "Direction",
                                                    "scale" => Dict("domain" => ["Charge", "Discharge"], "range" => ["#1baf7a", "#eb6834"])))),
            Dict("width" => 620, "height" => 90, "data" => Dict("values" => levels),
                 "mark" => Dict("type" => "area", "color" => "#2a78d6", "opacity" => 0.35, "line" => Dict("color" => "#2a78d6")),
                 "encoding" => Dict("x" => xaxis("Day"), "y" => Dict("field" => "kWh", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Stored energy (kWh)",
                                                                    "scale" => Dict("domain" => [0, capacity])))),
        ]))

    return nothing
end

using Printf
include("dp.jl")

# How much each added kWh of battery is worth, and how the schedule changes with size.
function main(inputs, report)
    m = Tsugumi.input(inputs, "scenario")
    sizes = sort(Float64.(inputs.params["capacities_kwh"]))
    shown = Float64.(inputs.params["schedule_sizes_kwh"])
    net_load = Float64.(m["load"]) .- Float64.(m["solar"])
    solve(price, capacity) = optimal_schedule(net_load, price, m["export_ratio"]; capacity, power=m["power_kw"],
                                              efficiency=m["round_trip_efficiency"], step=m["soc_step_kwh"])

    savings = Dict{String,Vector{Float64}}()
    rows = Dict{String,Any}[]
    marginal = Dict{String,Any}[]
    for (name, key) in (("Market-linked", "spot"), ("Time-of-use", "tou"))
        price = Float64.(m[key])
        baseline = no_battery_bill(net_load, price, m["export_ratio"])
        saved = [baseline - solve(price, c).bill for c in sizes]
        savings[key] = saved
        for i in eachindex(sizes)
            push!(rows, Dict("kWh" => sizes[i], "saved" => round(saved[i]; digits=1), "tariff" => name))
            i > 1 && push!(marginal, Dict("kWh" => (sizes[i] + sizes[i - 1]) / 2, "per" => round((saved[i] - saved[i - 1]) / (sizes[i] - sizes[i - 1]); digits=1), "tariff" => name))
        end
        report.log(string(name, ": ", join((@sprintf("%g kWh %.0f yen", sizes[i], saved[i]) for i in eachindex(sizes)), ", ")))
    end

    # The first three days of the schedule under the market tariff, at a few sizes.
    labels = [@sprintf("%g kWh", c) for c in shown]
    paths = Dict{String,Any}[]
    for (c, label) in zip(shown, labels)
        charge = solve(Float64.(m["spot"]), c).charge
        for t in 1:min(73, length(charge))
            push!(paths, Dict("day" => (t - 1) / 24, "share" => c > 0 ? round(charge[t] / c; digits=3) : 0.0, "size" => label))
        end
    end

    tariff_colors = Dict("domain" => ["Market-linked", "Time-of-use"], "range" => ["#2a78d6", "#1baf7a"])
    lines = Dict("type" => "line", "point" => true, "strokeWidth" => 1.8)
    report.vegalite(Dict(
        "\$schema" => "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v6.json",
        "background" => "white",
        "title" => Dict("text" => "More capacity, but the saving levels off",
                        "subtitle" => @sprintf("A made-up week, changing only the capacity at a power limit of %.1f kW", m["power_kw"])),
        "usermeta" => Dict("capacities" => sizes, "savings" => savings),
        "resolve" => Dict("scale" => Dict("color" => "independent")),
        "vconcat" => [
            Dict("hconcat" => [
                Dict("width" => 300, "height" => 170, "data" => Dict("values" => rows), "mark" => lines,
                     "encoding" => Dict("x" => Dict("field" => "kWh", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Capacity (kWh)"),
                                        "y" => Dict("field" => "saved", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Saving in a week (yen)"),
                                        "color" => Dict("field" => "tariff", "type" => "nominal", "legend" => nothing, "scale" => tariff_colors))),
                Dict("width" => 300, "height" => 170, "data" => Dict("values" => marginal), "mark" => lines,
                     "encoding" => Dict("x" => Dict("field" => "kWh", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Capacity (kWh, middle of the interval)"),
                                        "y" => Dict("field" => "per", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Saving per additional kWh (yen)"),
                                        "color" => Dict("field" => "tariff", "type" => "nominal", "title" => "Tariff", "scale" => tariff_colors))),
            ], "resolve" => Dict("scale" => Dict("color" => "independent"))),
            Dict("width" => 680, "height" => 120, "data" => Dict("values" => paths),
                 "title" => Dict("text" => "First 3 days, market-linked: state of charge by capacity", "fontSize" => 12),
                 "mark" => Dict("type" => "line", "strokeWidth" => 1.8),
                 "encoding" => Dict("x" => Dict("field" => "day", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "Day"),
                                    "y" => Dict("field" => "share", "type" => "quantitative", "title" => "State of charge", "axis" => Dict("format" => ".0%")),
                                    "color" => Dict("field" => "size", "type" => "nominal", "title" => "Capacity", "sort" => labels,
                                                    "scale" => Dict("range" => ["#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100"])))),
        ]))

    return nothing
end

using Printf
include("dp.jl")

# The same battery under four contracts. With a flat price and equal selling
# price, cycling only loses energy: the optimum is to stay still.
function main(inputs, report)
    m = Tsugumi.input(inputs, "scenario")
    net_load = Float64.(m["load"]) .- Float64.(m["solar"])
    capacity, ratio = m["capacity_kwh"], m["export_ratio"]
    percent = @sprintf("%.0f%%", 100ratio)
    scenarios = (("Flat, exports at the same price", "flat", 1.0), ("Flat, exports $percent", "flat", ratio),
                 ("Time-of-use, exports $percent", "tou", ratio), ("Market-linked, exports $percent", "spot", ratio))

    results = Dict{String,Any}[]
    paths = Dict{String,Any}[]
    for (name, key, sell) in scenarios
        price = Float64.(m[key])
        best = optimal_schedule(net_load, price, sell; capacity, power=m["power_kw"], efficiency=m["round_trip_efficiency"], step=m["soc_step_kwh"])
        saved = no_battery_bill(net_load, price, sell) - best.bill
        used = cycles(best.charge, capacity)
        report.log(string(@sprintf("%s: saved %.2f yen, %.2f cycles", name, saved, used)))
        push!(results, Dict("scenario" => name, "key" => key, "export_ratio" => sell, "saved" => saved, "cycles" => used,
                            "label" => @sprintf("%.0f yen · %.1f cycles", saved, used)))
        append!(paths, [Dict("day" => (t - 1) / 24, "kWh" => best.charge[t], "scenario" => name) for t in eachindex(best.charge)])
    end
    order = [s[1] for s in scenarios]
    colors = Dict("domain" => order, "range" => ["#8a8880", "#eda100", "#1baf7a", "#2a78d6"])

    report.vegalite(Dict(
        "\$schema" => "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v6.json",
        "background" => "white",
        "title" => Dict("text" => "The shape of the tariff decides the operation",
                        "subtitle" => @sprintf("The same battery (%.1f kWh, round-trip efficiency %.0f%%) run optimally under four contracts", capacity, 100m["round_trip_efficiency"])),
        "usermeta" => Dict("results" => results),
        "vconcat" => [
            Dict("width" => 620, "height" => 100, "data" => Dict("values" => results),
                 "layer" => [
                     Dict("mark" => Dict("type" => "bar", "cornerRadiusEnd" => 3, "height" => 16),

files.text:
# The dynamic program of the demo (the same file is in schedule, capacities,
# tariffs and check, so that each Card can be read and rerun alone).
#
# State: the charge of the battery, on a grid of `step` kWh. Each hour it moves
# to any level the power limit reaches, and the bill of that hour follows. The
# battery starts half full and must end where it started, so no stored energy
# is spent for free.

# Half of the round-trip loss is on the way in, half on the way out: `oneway`
# is sqrt(round-trip efficiency). A positive `stored` draws stored / oneway from
# the house's connection; a negative one gives it back -stored * oneway.
ac_energy(stored, oneway) = stored > 0 ? stored / oneway : stored * oneway

# The bill of one hour: what is bought costs `price`, what is sold earns `sell`.
hour_bill(grid, price, sell) = grid > 0 ? price * grid : sell * grid

function optimal_schedule(net_load, price, export_ratio; capacity, power, efficiency, step)
    hours = length(net_load)
    levels = round(Int, capacity / step)
    oneway = sqrt(efficiency)
    start = levels ÷ 2
    up = floor(Int, power * oneway / step + 1e-9)   # the most it can gain in an hour, in levels
    down = floor(Int, power / oneway / step + 1e-9) # the most it can lose

    # Backward: cost_to_go[s + 1] is the least bill from this hour on when the charge is s levels.
    cost_to_go = fill(Inf, levels + 1)
    cost_to_go[start + 1] = 0.0
    choice = zeros(Int, levels + 1, hours)
    for t in hours:-1:1
        next = copy(cost_to_go)
        for s in 0:levels
            best = hour_bill(net_load[t], price[t], export_ratio * price[t]) + next[s + 1] # staying wins ties
            best_to = s
            for to in max(0, s - down):min(levels, s + up)
                grid = net_load[t] + ac_energy((to - s) * step, oneway)
                cost = hour_bill(grid, price[t], export_ratio * price[t]) + next[to + 1]
                if cost < best - 1e-9
                    best, best_to = cost, to
                end
            end
            cost_to_go[s + 1] = best
            choice[s + 1, t] = best_to
        end
    end

    # Forward: follow the choices from the start.
    charge = zeros(hours + 1)
    grid = zeros(hours)
    s = start
    charge[1] = s * step
    for t in 1:hours
        to = choice[s + 1, t]
        grid[t] = net_load[t] + ac_energy((to - s) * step, oneway)
        s = to
        charge[t + 1] = s * step
    end
    bill = sum(hour_bill(grid[t], price[t], export_ratio * price[t]) for t in 1:hours; init=0.0)
    return (; bill, charge, grid)
end

no_battery_bill(net_load, price, export_ratio) =
    sum(hour_bill(net_load[t], price[t], export_ratio * price[t]) for t in eachindex(net_load))

# Energy that left the battery, in full cycles of its capacity.
function cycles(charge, capacity)
    capacity > 0 || return 0.0
    return sum(max(0.0, charge[t] - charge[t + 1]) for t in 1:length(charge)-1) / capacity
end

using Printf
include("dp.jl")

# Tries every path of charge levels over a short horizon: no shortcut, no table.
function brute_force(net_load, price, export_ratio; capacity, power, efficiency, step)
    levels = round(Int, capacity / step)
    oneway = sqrt(efficiency)
    start = levels ÷ 2
    up = floor(Int, power * oneway / step + 1e-9)
    down = floor(Int, power / oneway / step + 1e-9)
    hours = length(net_load)
    paths = 0
    function walk(t, s, bill)
        if t > hours
            paths += 1
            return s == start ? bill : Inf
        end
        best = Inf
        for to in max(0, s - down):min(levels, s + up)
            grid = net_load[t] + ac_energy((to - s) * step, oneway)
            best = min(best, walk(t + 1, to, bill + hour_bill(grid, price[t], export_ratio * price[t])))
        end
        return best
    end
    return walk(1, start, 0.0), paths
end

function main(inputs, report)
    m = Tsugumi.input(inputs, "scenario")
    hours = Int(inputs.params["brute_hours"])
    first_hour = Int(inputs.params["brute_from_hour"]) + 1
    window = first_hour:first_hour+hours-1
    net_load = Float64.(m["load"]) .- Float64.(m["solar"])
    ratio, efficiency = m["export_ratio"], m["round_trip_efficiency"]
    rows = Vector{Any}[]

    # 1. The DP against every path, on a small battery over a short horizon.
    for (name, key) in (("Flat", "flat"), ("Time-of-use", "tou"), ("Market-linked", "spot"))
        price = Float64.(m[key])[window]
        small = (capacity=2.0, power=1.0, efficiency=efficiency, step=0.5)
        dp = optimal_schedule(net_load[window], price, ratio; small...).bill
        brute, paths = brute_force(net_load[window], price, ratio; small...)
        abs(dp - brute) < 1e-8 || error("DP $dp differs from brute force $brute under $name")
        push!(rows, ["DP = exhaustive search ($(name), $(hours) hours, $(paths) paths)", @sprintf("%.4f yen", dp), @sprintf("%.4f yen", brute), "agree"])
    end

    # 2. A flat price with an equal selling price: cycling only loses energy.
    flat = Float64.(m["flat"])
    still = optimal_schedule(net_load, flat, 1.0; capacity=m["capacity_kwh"], power=m["power_kw"], efficiency, step=m["soc_step_kwh"])
    saved = no_battery_bill(net_load, flat, 1.0) - still.bill
    moved = cycles(still.charge, m["capacity_kwh"])
    efficiency < 1 && (abs(saved) < 1e-9 && moved == 0 || error("a flat tariff should leave the battery still"))
    push!(rows, ["Flat, exports at the same price: does not run", @sprintf("saving %.2f yen, %.2f cycles", saved, moved), "0 yen, 0 cycles", "agree"])

    # 3. A finer grid of charge levels can only do better, and soon stops mattering.
    spot = Float64.(m["spot"])
    step = m["soc_step_kwh"]
    previous = -Inf
    for k in 0:3
        fine = optimal_schedule(net_load, spot, ratio; capacity=m["capacity_kwh"], power=m["power_kw"], efficiency, step=step / 2^k)
        s = no_battery_bill(net_load, spot, ratio) - fine.bill
        s >= previous - 1e-6 || error("a finer grid earned less: $s after $previous")
        push!(rows, [@sprintf("Step of stored energy %.4g kWh (market-linked)", step / 2^k), @sprintf("%.2f yen", s), k == 0 ? "—" : @sprintf("%+.2f yen", s - previous), k == 0 ? "reference" : "increases"])
        previous = s
    end
    report.table(["Checked", "Value", "Expected", "Verdict"], rows)

    return nothing
end

notes.html:
Scheduling a battery

With the stored energy sts_t as the state, dynamic programming decides the charging and discharging for each hour. The data is all made up.

Vt(s)=min⁡s′[billt(s′−s)+Vt+1(s′)],VT(s)={0s=s0∞otherwiseV_t(s)=\min_{s'}\Big[\text{bill}_t(s'-s)+V_{t+1}(s')\Big],\quad V_T(s)=\begin{cases}0 & s=s_0\\ \infty & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}

With a one-way efficiency of η\sqrt{\eta}, one round trip of buying at plowp_{\rm low} and using at phighp_{\rm high} pays only when

η phigh>plow\eta\,p_{\rm high} > p_{\rm low}

At a flat tariff where buying and selling cost the same, phigh=plowp_{\rm high}=p_{\rm low}, so as long as η<1\eta<1 not running it is optimal (the top of tariffs). If exports are cheaper, moving surplus solar from midday to the night pays by that much.

Try the tariff of schedule, and capacity_kwh, round_trip_efficiency and export_ratio of settings.

The stored energy can only move on its step (soc_step_kwh), so the answer is slightly worse than the true optimum. The check table shows by how much. Forecast errors, battery wear and the cost of the equipment are not included.
